name: Golf coaching
summary: How expats start or restart golf in Singapore — driving-range lessons, club membership pathways, junior clinics, and humid-heat practice planning before course play.
body:
Singapore golf runs through public courses, private clubs, and dense driving-range coaching. Beginners usually build swing basics on mats before paying for scarce tee times. Trailing partners and teens often want short-game clinics rather than full memberships first.

## Formats
- Range packages with pro feedback
- On-course playing lessons
- Junior holiday clinics
- Club fitting after consistent contact
- Corporate / networking group sessions

Heat and afternoon storms reshape booking strategy — early slots fill first.

## How to choose
Prefer coaches who film swings and assign measurable drills, not only ball-count packages. Ask whether green fees are included in playing lessons. Confirm guest policies before assuming a friend can walk you onto a private club. Rent clubs through the first month.

## Practical tip
Bring electrolyte drinks and a towel; range bays bake at midday. Book a short game session before buying a full fourteen-club set you will not yet use.
